Q: mount unmount without sudo A:

Desktop linux distributions use udisks to grant non-root users limited mounting priviliges.

udisks version 2

udisksctl mount -b [device]

udisks version 1

udisks --mount [device]

Of course, if we are talking about a server VM, then these tools might not be installed. Installing them would require root access (once)

Q: How can I make Firefox's PDF viewer automatically re-load the PDF if it changes? A:

Summarizing the answer of the other person because it's a pain to read through:

Install npm and nodejs if you didn't

Run these (skip step 2 if you started your terminal in the same directory as your pdf):

npm i -g live-server
cd /path/to/your/pdf
live-server --watch=yourpdf.pdf

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8080 in your browser, click on your pdf file on the page that opens and that's it.

Good day to you :)

Q: How can I get a development role using Github? A:

No there is not a fixed number of pull requests for tech companies.

If you want to work at Sentry, checkout out their careers page: https://sentry.io/careers/

A lot of developers don't use Git Hub for personal projects. We do have our resumes like profiles on Linked In. We do post to job boards. If you're a serious developer & are good at it, it may just take time before a recruiter will reach out to you.

You could add Sentry to your Linked In profile, but it'll be lost in the noise. We all use technology stacks, which have dozens of software programs in it. Recruiters won't be looking for "Sentry" as their search term. They'll be looking for "Web Developer".

What I've done is build a website & show it off to recruiters during meetings in their office. When they saw that I could build something, which looked amazing... like https://www.clomp.com then they'd send me out to meet their clients. Try building a fun personal project & showing it off to others! Then they'll see you as a serious developer & may reach out to hire you.

Q: Android emulator for Chrome/WebGL2 browser automation on a server A:

If you target web games I don't see the point why you are focused on Chrome on Android. It might be easier trying to fake the Android browser environment without emulator, so just Chrome on Windows or Linux. Cloud servers with UI shouldn't be a problem.

Q: How to format fill color of a cell with RGB value stored in the cell? A:

What is your exact version of Excel? I have Microsoft® Excel® for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2605 Build 16.0.20026.20076) 64-bit and do not have either the RGBTOHEX function or the ability to paste a cell reference into the Hex field of the Conditional Formatting dialog.

When I try that pasting, it shows an error box: This is not a valid measurement

FYI, in my version of Excel, to convert an RGB string to a HEX value, I can use:

=DEC2HEX(SUMPRODUCT(--TEXTSPLIT(A2,","),{65536,256,1}))

and one could also use:

=TEXTJOIN(,,MAP(TEXTSPLIT(A2,","),LAMBDA(x, DEC2HEX(x,2))))
